deliverables: Constitute two advisory councils with charters, COI policies, member names, and published meeting minutes by week 6.
Form a dOSPO legal entity as a U.S. 501(c)(3) public charity with governance documents and an operator agreement by week 24.
Publish quarterly outcome reports with Mill Law Firm financial review attachments throughout the 12-month term.
Run a 2,000,000 ADA Maintenance Fund with dependency audit, SBOMs, centrality scores, bus factor assessments, retainer cohorts, and a CHAOSS-aligned health dashboard.
Operate four programs: Maintenance Fund, Maintainer Development, CodeForUs bounty program, and Ecosystem Activation Reserve.
request.recipient: Christian Taylor / Open Source Cowboy Consulting as sole Article II.7.5 administrator at withdrawal, with a planned transition target to a dOSPO 501(c)(3) public charity subject to governance.
request.what: Establish and operate a Cardano decentralized Open Source Program Office and Open Maintenance Framework for one year to fund and coordinate open source sustainability programs.

claims.claim: The proposer requests 4,094,000 ADA over 12 months to operate the Cardano dOSPO and OMF program.
Christian Taylor / Open Source Cowboy Consulting is designated as the sole Article II.7.5 funds administrator from treasury withdrawal through the 12-month period.
Mill Law Firm is designated as independent financial auditor on a quarterly cadence through Month 12.

The proposal says no disbursements will be made unilaterally because each allocation will be preceded by published advisory council feedback, while final allocation authority remains with the administrator.

The proposal states that DReps can replace the administrator or shut down the program through an on-chain Info Action, and that the proposer will sponsor such an Info Action if requested by 15 or more DReps.
The proposal claims selection for funding will follow published dependency centrality data rather than relationships.
Work Package 2 plans a full dependency audit in Months 1-3 using SBOMs in SPDX/CycloneDX format, centrality scoring, bus factor assessments, and a coverage gap analysis before retainer selection.
The proposal targets 15 or more high-centrality projects funded by the end of Month 12 and 40% of the top-50 dependencies funded by Month 12.
The proposer claims prior experience as Senior Manager of Open Source Governance and Head of OSPO at Intersect and says related history is verifiable via listed web and GitHub references.
The proposer says 90 pages of whitepapers vetted by experts detail how the structure will operate, but the supplied text does not include those whitepapers.

summary: The document describes a 4,094,000 ADA, 12-month treasury withdrawal to fund an independently administered Cardano open source sustainability office and maintenance framework, with named administration, auditor, advisory councils, reporting, dependency analysis, and retainer funding programs.
